problem_statement: The requester wants to experience the core mechanic of Elite: space docking. They seek a realistic physical simulation where a spacecraft approaches and docks with a rotating space station using keyboard controls, viewed in a Chrome browser. The ship must behave as a physical body with inertia, thrust, and rotation—not as a teleporting camera. The system must provide honest outcomes: successful docking at the airlock or collision with the station hull.
rationale: The request is well-specified with clear acceptance criteria, technically feasible within XS scope, and aligns with the stated constraints (TypeScript backend, docker-compose deployment, Chrome compatibility). The bounded scope (approach and docking only, not a full game) makes it achievable. The primary unknowns (2D vs 3D, specific physics requirements) are implementation details that can be resolved during development without changing the core value proposition.
